title: Caitlin Clark leaves Indiana Fever game with back issue
content:
INDIANAPOLIS — Indiana Fever star Caitlin Clark left Wednesday’s game in the third quarter with a back injury and did not return in the 111-109 loss to the Phoenix Mercury.

With the game tied 67-67, Clark subbed out with 5:15 left in the frame.

Clark finished with 19 points and eight assists in 20 minutes. Her abbreviated night snapped her WNBA record of six straight games with at least 20 points and five assists.

Clark, a two-time All-Star, has missed one game this season due to a sore back — a 90-73 victory over the Portland Fire on May 20. In the 13 games since, Clark had been listed as probable on the Fever’s injury report because of her back. She temporarily left the season opener multiple times with a back issue as well, saying afterward she was receiving adjustments.
